facts.claim: Norwegian Epic (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 2010; 155,873 GT; 4100 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Epic class.
Norwegian Epic is a cruise ship of the Norwegian Cruise Line built under NCL's F3 Project by the STX Europe Chantiers de l'Atlantique shipyard in Saint-Nazaire, France.

catalogSpecs.description: Revolutionary design with curved staterooms and The Haven.
